reviews.title: works.
reviews.comment:
Patriot Viper Venom DDR5 RAM 16GB (1X16GB) 6000MT/s CL30 UDIMM (hynix chips)
mixed with my Geil Golden Empire CL38-44-44 D5-5200 1x16GB (micron chips). Motherboard: ASRock B760M-CX Rev 1.03. Not the closest mix. When Giel was in slot 2 and Patriot in 4, machine not boot. With patriot in slot 2 and Geil in 4, booted up after about 4 minutes of thinking. So, it works. In retrospect, I should have gotten something a little closer to Geil which came with the machine.
All in all, satisfied that it worked. 32GB memory now.
